name: streamdeck-codex-companion
description: Independent Stream Deck companion for the Codex desktop app.
author: Todd

scripts.generated:check: npm run icons:lucide -- --check && npm run icons:static -- --check && npm run icons:wordmarks -- --check && npm run licenses:bundle -- --check && npm run profile:check
scripts.build:bundle: esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=com.todd.streamdeckcodex.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js --sourcemap
scripts.build: npm run icons:lucide && npm run icons:static && npm run icons:wordmarks && npm run licenses:bundle && npm run profile:generate && npm run native:build && npm run profile:build && npm run build:bundle
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.todd.streamdeckcodex.sdPlugin --output dist --force && prettier --write com.todd.streamdeckcodex.sdPlugin/manifest.json
scripts.link: npm run build && streamdeck link com.todd.streamdeckcodex.sdPlugin
scripts.check: npm run public:check && npm run generated:check && npm run native:build && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run qa:design && npm run build:bundle && npm run validate
scripts.release:bundle: npm run check && npm run pack && node scripts/stage-release.mjs
